title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of One Hundred thousand Pesos for the Payment of the Compensation of Tax Specialists and Other Expenses Incidental to the Revision of the Systems of Taxation Including the Tariff, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of one hundred thousand pesos to be spent for the payment of the compensation of
specialists in tax matters and such other persons as may be engaged by the Special Committee on Taxation,
with the approval of the Presiding Officers of both Houses, in accordance with the provisions of Concurrent
Resolution Numbered Thirty-one adopted on November seven, nineteen hundred and twenty-nine, as well as
for the payment of other incidental expenses which may be necessary for the proper compliance of the
purposes set forth in said Resolution.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 20, 1930.
